title: GPUDirect RDMA：拷貝路徑與 PCIe 下界
titleEn: GPUDirect RDMA: copy paths and PCIe lower bounds
summary: 以合成資料重建「GPUDirect RDMA：拷貝路徑與 PCIe 下界」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付兩種資料路徑、時間下界、同步契約與相容性待確認清單。
summaryEn: Reconstruct GPUDirect RDMA: copy paths and PCIe lower bounds with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver both data paths, time bounds, synchronization contracts and unresolved compatibility checks.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 若 direct 路徑更慢，查 GPU/NIC PCIe 拓樸、IOMMU 相容性、記憶體註冊與同步，不把零拷貝當零成本。
只有路徑相容且結果正確時可測 direct；本課數字不是實際設備效能承諾。
GPUDirect RDMA 可支援 NIC 與 GPU 記憶體直接資料路徑；本課比較有無主機 staging 的序列下界。
optionsEn: A slower direct path requires checking GPU/NIC topology, IOMMU compatibility, registration and synchronization; zero-copy is not zero-cost.
Test a direct path only with compatibility and correctness established; these figures are not hardware performance promises.
GPUDirect RDMA supports NIC-to-GPU memory paths; compare sequential lower bounds with and without host staging.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。GPUDirect RDMA 可支援 NIC 與 GPU 記憶體直接資料路徑；本課比較有無主機 staging 的序列下界。 與本階段判準一起判讀：直接資料路徑不表示 CPU 控制或同步消失。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. GPUDirect RDMA supports NIC-to-GPU memory paths; compare sequential lower bounds with and without host staging. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: A direct data path does not imply absence of CPU control or synchronization.

steps.instruction:
分別算 0.25 s 拷貝與 0.32 s 網路；若允許流水重疊，需另建 max 模型。
回到本階段實驗：畫 GPU、host DRAM、NIC 三節點，為 staging 畫兩段，direct 畫一段；另標控制路徑。
把名義組與變更組並列，逐欄確認只改了預定條件；若需多變量，另開實驗編號。用同一單位檢查趨勢、偏差與判準：直接資料路徑不表示 CPU 控制或同步消失。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute 0.25 s copy and 0.32 s network separately; pipelining requires a distinct max model.
Return to the investigation: Draw GPU, host DRAM and NIC nodes with two staging segments and one direct segment; label control paths separately.
Compare nominal and changed runs column by column, confirming that only intended conditions changed. Give multi-variable experiments separate IDs. Check trend, bias, and criterion in common units: A direct data path does not imply absence of CPU control or synchronization.
steps.observation: 對照組與變更組的差異能追到明確輸入或量測機制。分別算 0.25 s 拷貝與 0.32 s 網路；若允許流水重疊，需另建 max 模型。
steps.observationEn: Differences between control and changed runs trace to explicit inputs or measurement mechanisms. Compute 0.25 s copy and 0.32 s network separately; pipelining requires a distinct max model.
steps.failure: 同時變更多個輸入卻把結果歸因於單一因素。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple inputs and attributing the output difference to a single factor.
steps.check: 直接資料路徑不表示 CPU 控制或同步消失。
steps.checkEn: A direct data path does not imply absence of CPU control or synchronization.

options: 名義式 8/32+8/25 = 0.57 s；變更式 8/25 = 0.32 s。只移除 8 GB 主機 staging 拷貝，網路有效頻寬維持 25 GB/s。 全部負載、量測和門檻是原創教學假設，不是產品規格。
交付兩種資料路徑、時間下界、同步契約與相容性待確認清單。

optionsEn: Nominal: 8/32+8/25 = 0.57 s; changed: 8/25 = 0.32 s. Remove only the 8 GB host staging copy and retain 25 GB/s effective network bandwidth. All workload measurements and thresholds are original teaching assumptions, not product specifications.
Deliver both data paths, time bounds, synchronization contracts and unresolved compatibility checks.
A slower direct path requires checking GPU/NIC topology, IOMMU compatibility, registration and synchronization; zero-copy is not zero-cost.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. A slower direct path requires checking GPU/NIC topology, IOMMU compatibility, registration and synchronization; zero-copy is not zero-cost. steps.title: 資料路徑著色 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Color data paths · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「資料路徑著色」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Color data paths and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若 direct 路徑更慢，查 GPU/NIC PCIe 拓樸、IOMMU 相容性、記憶體註冊與同步，不把零拷貝當零成本。
對照「資料路徑著色」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只有路徑相容且結果正確時可測 direct；本課數字不是實際設備效能承諾。
本階段必須重驗：直接資料路徑不表示 CPU 控制或同步消失。
steps.instructionEn:
A slower direct path requires checking GPU/NIC topology, IOMMU compatibility, registration and synchronization; zero-copy is not zero-cost.
Against the nominal Color data paths result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Test a direct path only with compatibility and correctness established; these figures are not hardware performance promises.
Reverify this criterion: A direct data path does not imply absence of CPU control or synchronization.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若 direct 路徑更慢，查 GPU/NIC PCIe 拓樸、IOMMU 相容性、記憶體註冊與同步，不把零拷貝當零成本。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A slower direct path requires checking GPU/NIC topology, IOMMU compatibility, registration and synchronization; zero-copy is not zero-cost.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 直接資料路徑不表示 CPU 控制或同步消失。
steps.checkEn: A direct data path does not imply absence of CPU control or synchronization.

Deliver both data paths, time bounds, synchronization contracts and unresolved compatibility checks.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Color data paths: A direct data path does not imply absence of CPU control or synchronization.
